I am taking System Commands for the first time.

/opt/se2001/vmt_1.0 matched the assignment_0 example in the VM Login Process section in the SEEK course portal. I encountered an issue while I was getting familiar with the Course_VM where my script.sh was not allowed to be executed. Upon inspection, I found that it lacked the necessary permissions.

Is this normal? Do I have to manually add execution permissions for my scripts?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
SarthakJalota:

Do I have to manually add execution permissions for my scripts?

Yes, you have to manually give execution permission.

posts.name: Atharv Sanjeev Kumar
posts.cooked: for some assignments it asks for permission like practice,vmt. PPAs work fine idk why

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Check the evaluation script, for some assignments the evaluation script has chmod +x command which makes your script executable that’s why those don’t require explicit permissions while others require.
